title: Bois & raquettes de tennis de table
subtitle: annonces vérifiées sur photo (revêtements, sacs et vêtements écartés)

product_class.BLADE: a table-tennis blade/wood base without rubber attached (bois, blade, Schlägerholz, madeira sem borracha)
product_class.RACKET: a finished racket with rubber attached (raquette, schläger, table tennis racket, pala con goma, set containing a racket)

vars.auxiliary_note: table-tennis rubber/sheet (revêtement/gomme) without a blade, or rubber+blade combo listed as rubber
vars.other_note: anything else: rubber only, balls, apparel, tables, nets, bags, unrelated items
vars.auxiliary_hint: rubber visible = RACKET, bare wood = BLADE
